title: Continual Learning
summary: Designing agents that keep learning and adapting throughout deployment, rather than freezing after training. We study plasticity loss, catastrophic forgetting, and learning under non-stationarity.

title: Representation Learning
summary: Learning compact, reusable state representations — including sparse representations and recurrent architectures — that make downstream prediction and control more sample-efficient.

title: Model-Based RL & Planning
summary: Building learned models of the world from options and value functions, and planning with them to make good decisions from limited data.

title: Off-Policy Learning
summary: Learning about many policies and predictions from a single stream of experience — the foundation for scalable predictive knowledge and general value functions.

title: Reinforcement Learning Theory
summary: Sound, approximate policy iteration and action-value methods, with an emphasis on guarantees that hold under function approximation.

title: Real-World Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deploying RL in the physical world — water treatment automation, industrial control, scientific instruments — where sample efficiency, safety, and continual adaptation matter most.
